title: Ship Engines
description: Required design choice unless the chosen bite declares it needs no engine. The motive force behind the ship's bite.

options.name: Chemical Compressor
options.description: The most common engine on the rustling waves, reliably unreliable but extremely easy to fuel.
options.special: Fuelled with crushed fruit and insect husks.

options.name: Springwork
options.description: Wound exhaustively by hand, storing and releasing kinetic energy with surprising efficiency.
options.special: Fuelled with sweat, labour, and time spent winding.

options.name: Parasite Pitcher
options.description: A large pitcher plant coaxed into taking root in an engine housing, vines intermingling with the ship's systems.
options.special: Fuelled with organic material, preferably living.

options.name: Steam Piping
options.description: Hellish contraptions of tangled piping, rare chemicals, and scalding steam.
options.special: Fuelled with water, the cleaner the better.

options.name: Ratwheel Exchange
options.description: A pure transfer of kinetic energy from restless rats to wheel to bite.
options.special: The rats need feeding every now and then, but they're not fussy.

options.name: Pulsing Cocoon
options.description: An unknown insect shifts inside, glutting on dreams and spinning them into an ebb of arconautic force.
options.special: Fuelled with the dreams of the crew. Crews report intensely vivid dreams.

options.name: Tamed Hive
options.description: A buzzing organic engine of honeycombs and crawling workers, their movements a complex dance.
options.special: Fuelled with stolen flowers and unprocessed pollen. Crew can gain 'Fresh Engine-Honey' once per journey.

options.name: Reclaimed Burner
options.description: An ancient burner that runs on processed chemical fuel, salvaged from the innards of a pre-verdant ship. Requires excessive ventilation.
options.special: Runs on processed chemical fuel. Liable to explode if seriously damaged.

options.name: Rope Golem
options.description: A semi-sentient mass of animated ropes running through the rooms and corridors of the ship.
options.special: Takes no fuel, but the ropes must be replaced when they begin to fray. Rope golems have an unpredictable will.

options.name: Leviathan Heart
options.description: An actual leviathan heart, still beating reflexively, hooked up to the ship. Pumps viscous black fuel through pipes and valves.
options.special: Requires no fuel, but in a particularly ominous way.

options.name: Jawbox
options.description: Noisy, wood-fuelled engines that create huge clouds of smoke and dust but with minimum chance of flame.

options.name: Ceramic Batteries
options.description: Volt-storing batteries rigged up to regulate and distribute power. Their crackling hum makes nearby insects uneasy.

options.name: Solar Compressor
options.description: Made to store, liquefy, and pressurize sunlight.

options.name: Magnetic Coils
options.description: Spinning cylinders that, ideally, maintain a state of almost perpetual motion.

options.name: Acid Maw
options.description: An open chemical vat that melts down scrap metal, piping the resulting pressurised slurry around the ship.
